_doc: Top-down objects for the Unity client (unity/Assets/Scripts/Runtime/World.cs). Buildings: along — the length in metres of the wall that runs west–east (the south front, the left wall in the picture); the other wall's length comes from the picture (unity/tools/prepare.py measures the wall bases and the front corner). Everything else: size — the picture's width on the screen in metres; solid — the radius in metres that cannot be walked through (0 — walk through); where — the kinds of places it stands in (town, harbour, shore, wild, desert, under); near — road (by the streets), water (on the shore or by the pier), any.
